To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the EVA/PLA blend and EVA/ PEG blend were successfully applied as the drug carriers in bi-layer drug- loaded stent coating film.
the EVA/PLA or EVA/PEG blend can be used as the drug carrier material for drug-loaded stents, and the drug release can be tuned by changing the composition of the blends.

the polymeric blend films of EVA/PLA or EVA/PEG can be used as the coating film materials for drug-loaded bi-layer stents, and the drug release profiles of these bi-layer films could be easily controlled by adjusting the contents of blend components.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of bi-layer drug-loaded polymeric films for drug-loaded stents.
the preparation of a bi-layer stent coating film based on the drug-loaded polymeric blend and the investigation of the effects of the polymeric blend on the drug release behavior.

the development of a new type of polymeric blend as drug carrier for a paclitayel-eluting stents coating film, and this work could contribute to the development of new drug-eluting stent coating films.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the bi-layer film structure is a promising drug delivery system for the development of a drug-eluting stent.
the polymeric blend films could be used as a biocompatible, biodegradable and tunable drug delivery system for the drug-eluting stent.
EVA/PLA/PTX and EVA/PLG/PTX blend films were developed as drug-eluting stent coating films with tunable drug release profiles.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the polymeric blends were promising drug carrier materials for the application of drug-eluting stent.
the bi-layer film structure could be applied as the drug-loaded coating material for drug-eluting stents.

a bi-layer stent coating film consisting of a PTX-loaded EVA/PLA or EVA/PEG layer and a drug free EVA layer could be fabricated, which could be applied as a novel drug-eluting stent (DES) with the release of PTX in a unidirectionally controlled fashion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
polymeric blend materials can be useful for drug delivery applications, especially for drug-eluting stent applications.
the polymeric blends can be used as the carrier materials for drug loaded stent coating film.
the EVA/PLA blend and EVA/PEO blend can be used as drug carrier materials for the preparation of a drug-loaded coating film for a drug-eluting stent.
